subject: Plotting data from database, and show in Shiny

messages.author: f9c5f1187ca3c5b6
messages.subject: Plotting data from database, and show in Shiny
parts:
Hi All,

I am able to display the database data in a Table in Shiny, but I am not able to display its data in a Plot with plotData(). Why is this so?
I test with some generic data (cars) and it is able to display it.

I still cannot figure out why.

See code below:

library(lubridate)
library(RMySQL)
library(DBI)
library(shiny)
library(dygraphs)
library(xts)
library(magrittr)

options(mysql = list(
  "host" = "www.abcde.net",
  "port" = 3306,
  "user" = "abcdefgh",
  "password" = "XXXXXXXXX"
))
databaseName <- "database123"
table <- "table123"

server <- function(input, output) {
  
  startime <- reactive({
    start_time <-input$starttime
  })
  
  endtime <- reactive({
    end_time <-input$endtime
  })
  
  loadData <- function() {
    # Connect to the database
    db <- dbConnect(MySQL(), dbname = databaseName, host = options()$mysql$host, 
                    port = options()$mysql$port, user = options()$mysql$user, 
                    password = options()$mysql$password)
    start_time <- startime()
    end_time <- endtime()
    query <- paste("SELECT * from PunggolCentral ",
                   "WHERE DateTime > STR_TO_DATE('",start_time,"', '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s')",
                   "AND DateTime < STR_TO_DATE('",end_time,"', '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s')",sep="")
    
    # Submit the fetch query and disconnect
    data <- dbGetQuery(db, query)
    #dbDisconnect(db)
    on.exit(dbDisconnect(db), add = TRUE)
    data
  }
  
  plotData <- function() {
    # Connect to the database
    db <- dbConnect(MySQL(), dbname = databaseName, host = options()$mysql$host,
                    port = options()$mysql$port, user = options()$mysql$user,
                    password = options()$mysql$password)
    start_time <- startime()
    end_time <- endtime()
    
    start_time = "2013/01/01 00:30:00"
    end_time = "2013/01/03 00:30:00"
    query <- paste("SELECT * from PunggolCentral ",
                   "WHERE DateTime > STR_TO_DATE('",start_time,"', '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s')",
                   "AND DateTime < STR_TO_DATE('",end_time,"', '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s')",sep="")

    # Submit the fetch query and disconnect
    data <- dbGetQuery(db, query)
    dbDisconnect(db)
    data_DT <- as.POSIXct(data$DateTime,format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    data_TS <- xts(data$Consumption,order.by=data_DT)

    theGraph <- dygraph(data_TS, main = "Punggol Water Consumption") %>%
      dySeries("V1", label = "Hourly Water Consumption (m^3)") %>%
      dyLegend(show = "always", hideOnMouseOut = FALSE)

    print(theGraph)
  }
  
  output$text <- renderText({  
    paste("You have selected:",input$starttime)
  })  
  
  
  output$table <- renderDataTable({
    input$starttime
    input$endtime
    loadData()
  })  
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    input$starttime
    input$endtime
    #plotData()
    cars2 <- cars + rnorm(nrow(cars))
    plot(cars2)
  })
  
}
